cross_review.status: Read in full; identified clarity issues directly repaired; no new unresolved arithmetic blocker found
repairs: Root22 common instructions: save temporary snippet scripts in project root and use the same environment interpreter, avoiding broken from examples imports.
GLM: log2 ambiguity replaced by natural ln(2); PCA: explain n, Sigma, transpose, @ and axis=0; Smith-Waterman: define sequence indices, score and gap.
Welch/paired and chi-square/Fisher numeric P checkpoints copied from existing root-snippets.json; code blocks unchanged.

Guide: separate first-time venv creation from existing environment; full PowerShell commands; direct standard-library genetics/omics examples; clarify --list, --case, --output and distinct JSON schemas.
HMM: explain that illustrative complete-path copying has extra time cost beyond optimized backpointer recurrence.
BWT: put dollar sentinel and transformed string in code formatting to prevent unintended math rendering.
Math bridge: dimensions, matrix multiplication and log definitions have checkable output; no substantive correction needed.

findings.page: 单细胞降维邻居图与聚类原理
findings.location: 模块度定义段，当前第29行
findings.question: “m为总边权的一半”是否会被读作把每条无向边只计一次的边权总和再减半？
findings.evidence: 标准模块度中2m=sum_ij A_ij，m为无向边权各计一次的总和。NetworkX官方modularity说明明确这一点。
findings.correction: 已改为对称邻接矩阵、k_i=sum_j A_ij、2m=sum_ij A_ij，并写清每条无向边在矩阵中计两次。
findings.verification: 已读取最终段，定义与公式相容。

findings.page: 微生物组组成差异与多样性方法
findings.location: 多样性与距离段，当前第33行
findings.question: Bray–Curtis的“变换值”是否会被误用为前一段含负数的clr坐标？
findings.evidence: 文中非绝对值分母的常用丰度式需要非负输入且分母非零。clr分量和为0，直接套此式会出现零分母。SciPy官方定义亦区分正输入的有界性质。
findings.correction: 已限定非负丰度/保持非负的变换、分母非零；明确clr不能直接套该式，补充clr后的常见Aitchison/欧氏几何；Shannon数值改写ln(2)消除log2歧义。
findings.verification: 已读取最终段，条件及例子1/6均正确。
